dedupe_keys.name: zjazdnost sk slovak road condition winter weather and restriction maps

description: zjazdnost.sk publishes maps of road passability in Slovakia. On 2026-09-29 the map page offered layers for the road surface state, the surface state on mountain passes, the type of snow layer, sections with frost, black ice or frozen snow (shown in red), weather, air temperature bands, reduced visibility bands and traffic restrictions by validity. Coverage: Slovak roads, with emphasis on winter conditions. Format and access: an interactive web map. Licence and cost: free to consult; no reuse licence is stated. Caveats: a viewer, not a data download, and the page is in Slovak; the operator is not named on the map page. It supports emergency response and hazard exposure studies of winter road conditions. It relates to the EU list of national access points and DATEX II in the catalogue.
name: zjazdnost.sk: Slovak road condition, winter weather and restriction maps
